title: RTL Interface Domain Configuration
description: Describes top-level input clock, reset, synchronous data, and asynchronous data domains for an RTL design boundary.

signal_name.description: Exact top-level input port name. Interface port members use the qualified form '<interface_port>.<member>'; the interface port name is the only valid qualifier.

signal_wildcard.description: Wildcard prefix representing a group of top-level input ports (may span an interface port qualifier, e.g. 'bus.*').

module_name.description: Name of the RTL module this configuration applies to.

clock_domains.description: Mapping of top-level clock input domains to their configuration.

additionalProperties.title: Clock Domain
additionalProperties.description: Definition of a top-level clock input domain.

input_name.description: Optional top-level clock input port name. If omitted, the domain name is used.

polarity.description: Clock edge used by sequential logic in this domain.

inputs_outputs.description: List of top-level synchronous data input ports belonging to this clock domain.

resets.description: Mapping of top-level reset input domains to their configuration.

additionalProperties.title: Reset Domain
additionalProperties.description: Definition of a top-level reset input signal.

signal_name.description: Optional top-level reset input port name. If omitted, the reset domain name is used.

polarity.description: Reset polarity by level. 'positive' means active-high reset, 'negative' means active-low reset.

async_domain.description: List of top-level data input ports that are asynchronous to all defined clock domains.
